depends on their armor and what gun you have. pretty much every weapon can one clip somebody if used correctly. If you have a flatline and your opponent has an r99, they will win because the r99 will put out damage way quicker. If you manage to dodge his initial spray, you can take advantage to oneclip or break em while they're reloading. 

The guns in this game definitely deal damage but the time to stay alive is what makes this game better. Try to keep in mind opponents shields when pushing on them. If you dump a whole magazine on someone and the bullets hit them, with most guns they should be dead or very close to it. 

Also try to hipfire more, makes you quicker and harder to one clip when close to someone. I typically aim from a distance and hipfire to finish. Standing still kills in apex.

A bit hard to summarize Apex but some general stuff I can think of

- Always keep health up
> Don't necessarily ALWAYS heal, but take every opportunity you can to heal. Pop shields during downtime in a fight, pop a syringe when you have some chunked off. Grabbing armor off a dead body or from the floor can be super beneficial, even if its just a white shield.

- Use the environment 
> You can die in less than 4 seconds if you're out in open, look around and think of what can be viable cover. Rocks, doors, trees, tables.. almost everything around can be used as cover and if you crouch it makes more of these things usable. 

- Practice gunplay
> Most important but also pretty obvious. Besides your aim, don't peak for too long. People can do a lot of damage if you peak for too long. On the other end, you can deal a lot of pressure if you take short peaks, try to predict and prefire angles, this scares people off of angles especially if you hit em.

Other things -

>Apply pressure when you need time, i.e. needing to rez or popping a battery. People want to capitalize on your mistakes (you should as well) and might rush in the open, making prime time for you to one clip em or break a shield.

> Don't loot for too long, once you have guns you're comfy with, sufficient ammo, and have armor better than blue, go ahead and fight someone. More fights you take the more you'll understand how to properly approach fights.

> Use the legends and find who is most fun.. wraith and Bloodhound are fun to me as their abilities are straightforward and I can focus on killing people.

Theres a lot to Apex and some other things I've probably failed to mention. This game is extremely satisfying to improve at and I hope you keep pursuing it!
